name: New 52-Week Highs: Does Momentum Persist?
description: Analyzes forward 21-day (1-month) returns after equities make new 252-day closing highs. Detects new high events via highestbars, computes forward price returns, and shows the distribution of outcomes with hit rate, median, and tail statistics. Applied to SPY, QQQ, and IWM to compare momentum persistence across large-cap, tech, and small-cap segments.
source:
# New 52-Week Highs: Does Momentum Persist?
# Detects when close makes a new 252-day high, then measures
# forward 21-day returns to test if breakout momentum continues.

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Signal Detection ---
# New 252-day closing high: highestbars returns 0 when current bar IS the high
bars_since_high = highestbars(period=252)(close)
is_new_high = bars_since_high == 0

# --- Forward Returns (21 trading days ~ 1 calendar month) ---
fwd_21d = forward_returns(period=21)(close)

# Forward return only on new-high days (sparse — NaN elsewhere)
fwd_at_high = where(is_new_high, fwd_21d)

# --- Win Rate (dense 0/1 for correct Mean aggregation) ---
# S29: use ternary, NOT where(cond, 1.0) which makes losses NaN
win_flag = 1.0 if (is_new_high and is_valid(fwd_21d) and fwd_21d > 0) else 0.0
# Only count bars that are actual new-high events with valid forward data
event_flag = 1.0 if (is_new_high and is_valid(fwd_21d)) else 0.0

# --- Event Markers ---
# Capture each new 52-week high with forward return and close price
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='New 52-Week High',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Fwd 21d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(close, fwd_21d, is_new_high)

# --- Output 1: Distribution of Forward Returns ---
# With N likely 100+ per ETF, histogram is appropriate
histogram(
    title='Do New Highs Lead to More Gains?',
    bins=30,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_label='21-Day Forward Return',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    category='52-Week High Momentum',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(fwd_at_high)

# --- Output 2: Cross-Sectional Comparison ---
# One bar per ETF showing median forward return — the punchline
cs_bars(
    mode=CSBarMode.simple,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Which Market Segment Has Strongest Post-Breakout Momentum?',
    y_axis_label='Median 21-Day Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    category='52-Week High Momentum',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=fwd_at_high)

# --- Output 3: Summary Statistics Table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Post-Breakout Forward Return Stats (21 Days)',
        row_size=5, col_size=1,
        row_headers=['Event Count', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)', 'Best Outcome', 'Worst Outcome'],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum,
                       type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='52-Week High Momentum',
    order=3
)(event_flag, fwd_at_high, win_flag, fwd_at_high, fwd_at_high)
